detail.longDescription: Also want to acknowledge that the way I built sync isn't original to me at all. All this refactoring started with me wanting to write something similar for Bandcamp. Then I came across the excellent BancampSync project. Looking at the code I thought it had a simple, elegant, and robust way to detecting duplicates. And so I copied it :) https:// github.com/meeb/bandcampsync/ # Python # LibroFM # audiobooks # selfhosted
